title: Custom widgets can be pinned to the top of the page, always visible
summary: The custom widget builder has a new "Pin to top of the page" toggle. Turn it on and that widget shows in its own row right below the Home header -- always visible, not part of the resizable grid below -- instead of being a normal tile you add/remove/resize. Same widget types and edit flow as before (info card, link tiles, live stat); pinning is just a toggle on where it shows, not a separate kind of widget. Turning it back off returns it to a normal grid widget.
